title: Show HN: Minimal, no-JS web forum software
guide_zh: 不用 JavaScript 的极简论坛，采用 SQLite 并以便于自托管为目标。
author: demindiro
excerpt: Hello HN! I've found my SQL knowledge to be lacking, so I made a project that uses SQLite as a backend. As it is intended for self-hosting I aim to make it easy to set up and maintain. Getting it up & running takes no more than a few commands (bar setting up a proxy such as nginx, which is out of scope). I've set up a "demo" site at https://forum.agreper.com/ if you want to try out the UI.
